title: UAV Crop-Weed Reliability Scoping Review — Evaluation-Setting Charting Schema
description: Validates charted evaluation-setting rows linked to study/report families (protocol proto-20261012-uav-crop-weed-reliability). Repeated random seeds are grouped within a setting; materially distinct dataset, split, shift, or target-data-use conditions require separate rows. FROZEN v0.3.1 (2026-10-31) — repairs limitation F1 by coupling evidence_state to content and provenance. Supersedes v0.3.0.

study_id.description: Canonical Study Family ID (STU-*) or deduplicated workspace cluster ID (SCI-*).

setting_id.description: Unique evaluation-setting index within the study family (e.g., SET-01 for in-domain block split, SET-02 for cross-year transfer).

coder_id.description: Identifier of the human researcher or dual-coding pass (e.g., 'mouadh', 'soumia', 'fadhila', 'consensus').

full_text_verified.description: Formal charting requires verified full text; abstract-only charting is prohibited per RESEARCHER_DECISIONS.md #6.

linked_reports.description: Preprints (arXiv/bioRxiv/SSRN), conference versions, or dataset repositories (Zenodo/Mendeley) belonging to the same study family.

crop_species.description: Standardized crop common or Latin names (e.g., ['maize'], ['barley', 'rapeseed'], ['sugar_beet']).

dataset_names.description: Named datasets used in this setting (e.g., ['WeedsGalore'], ['BAWSeg'], ['WeedMap_2018_RedEdge'], ['Custom_Sorghum_UAV']).

spectral_bands.description: Explicit physical bands ingested by the model (e.g., ['R', 'G', 'B', 'RE', 'NIR']).

derived_indices_used.description: Vegetation or color indices computed and used (e.g., ['ExG', 'NDVI', 'NDRE', 'CIVE', 'HSV']).

temporal_regime.description: Per Decision #6, strictly separate multiple_dates_pooled_no_heldout from heldout_date_or_growth_stage_same_season and heldout_cross_season_or_cross_year.

crop_growth_stages_bbch.description: Reported growth stages or BBCH codes (e.g., 'BBCH 15, 17, 19' or 'seedling vs pre-harvest').

matched_modality_ablation_present.description: True ONLY if the study compares multimodal fusion against a matched single-modality baseline (e.g., RGB+MS vs RGB-only with the same backbone and split).

abstention_or_validity_rejection.description: True if the method can reject/abstain on invalid predictions (e.g., In-Row Concentration Ratio IRCR gate or risk-aware rejection).

weed_class_specific_metrics_reported.description: True if weed-specific IoU/F1/AP is reported separately from background/soil and crop classes.

repeated_seeds_or_folds_count.description: Number of random seeds or cross-validation runs grouped within this setting.

delta_transfer_drop.description: Target metric minus Source metric (negative value indicates performance degradation under shift).

failed_transfer_documented.description: True if the study explicitly reports a severe performance breakdown or failure mode under transfer or stress.

evidence_state.description: Strict epistemic state of the charted dimension and the authority over its content: reported requires the reported values plus a content quote; not_reported/unavailable/not_applicable require every value field to be empty plus an absence quote; conflicting requires empty value fields, two mutually inconsistent content quotes (provenance + additional_provenance), and a narrative describing the conflict. Never collapse not_reported (authors omitted it in full text) with unavailable (full text or supplement inaccessible) or not_applicable.

absence_check.description: false when verbatim_quote is reported content supporting a value; true when it records the explicit absence check. Enforced by each dimension: reported/conflicting require false; not_reported/unavailable/not_applicable require true.

verbatim_quote.description: Exact verbatim substring from the verified full text supporting the charted value, or explicit statement of absence (e.g., '[Checked Section 2 & 3: no split grouping unit stated]').

locator.description: Section, page, table, or figure identifier (e.g., 'Section 3.2, p. 6, Table 2').
